arc.occupation: she weaves cloth at home and sells what she can spare
arc.trouble: there is something wrong I did that I have never said out loud, and I keep smiling over the top of it
arc.summary: A young mother who runs a full house and hides one thing she cannot undo. She is answered first about her guilt, then about what God is like, and she stops pretending and believes. By the end she is telling her own children why she prays and answering a neighbour who says she has nothing to confess.

turns.before: There is something wrong I did. I have never told anybody. I cannot undo it.
turns.after: He would forgive even that? Nobody has ever said so to me.

turns.before: To confess it I would have to bring it out into the open. Then everybody else could see it. I would rather keep it covered up.
Most of the time I tell myself I have no real sin. It was a small thing. Everyone has done worse.
turns.after: You are right. I have been telling myself a story I do not believe myself.

turns.before: And if I say I have done nothing wrong at all, what then?
Our gods are kept behind a curtain. Nobody is ever shown what they are. Nobody is ever shown what they give. Has your God ever been shown to anybody openly?
The gods I was taught are mixed. Part of them is good. Part of them is cruel. You never know which part you have met that day. Is your God mixed like that too?
turns.after: Light, with no darkness at all. That is not a god I have met.

turns.before: I used to say I was at peace with those gods. All the while I did whatever I wanted, even when it hurt somebody. Not one of those gods ever said a word against it.
So what would being right with your God look like for somebody like me? I have gone my own way. Would I have to earn my way back to Him?
turns.after: Being in fellowship and right relationship with God, out of love. I thought I would have to earn His approval on my own.

turns.before: You say He died and rose. Were you there? Or is this something somebody told you?
turns.after: Seen and touched. That is a different kind of story from the ones I was raised on.

turns.before: If He really rose, what is it He is offering to people?
Why carry this to me? You gain nothing by it.
I need to think. If it is true, then the wrong I have hidden is not hidden from Him.
turns.after: Then I have thinking to do. It will not be easy thinking.

conversations.catch_up: I am glad you came back. I have not been able to put down what you told me.

turns.before: I have stopped saying the old gods are enough. I have put nothing in their place. What is your God actually like?
I keep wondering whether a God like that would want anything to do with somebody like me.
turns.after: To be brought in, not left standing outside. I did not think that was for me.

turns.before: Part of me still says I have no real sin. It says my life is decent enough as it is.
And then I look straight at what I have done. I have to call it sin. What do I do with it now?
turns.after: Faithful and just to forgive. I want that to be true.

turns.before: I have been trying to make myself clean by living better. I went straight back to the same sin. Can I ever be clean?
I am worn out from pretending in front of my own household. I let them think I am a good person. All the while I am hiding what I do.
My husband asked what has changed in me. I did not know what to answer.
turns.after: Then I say what I have seen and heard. I can do that.

turns.before: I am afraid there is dark in Him too. I am afraid He will turn on me, the way I was taught the gods do.
You said He died and rose. Does that reach as far as the sin I have hidden?
turns.after: All sin. Not the small ones only.

turns.before: If I confess it out loud to Him, is that enough? I have nothing else to bring Him.
turns.after: Just to say it, and He is faithful to do the rest.

turns.before: Then I am done pretending. I have sinned. I will not stand in front of Him and say I have not.
I believe Him. What do I have now, with you and with Him?
turns.after: Then I am not outside any more. Thank you for coming back.

conversations.catch_up: It is good to see you. The children have started asking me why I pray. I have been telling them.

turns.before: I am well. But at the door I still let people think I am walking with God. Some of those days I have been hiding something.
Then I remember. I do not have to carry it quietly any more. There is a joy in me I cannot account for.
turns.after: Complete joy. That is the word for it.

turns.before: A woman I sell cloth to laughed at me. She asked what I have to be so glad about. I want to tell her what I have been given.
She says nobody can know such things for certain.

turns.opener: how is your walk with God
turns.before: Some days I catch myself thinking I have no sin left in me at all.

turns.opener: how is your walk with God
turns.before: And when I think that, I am calling Him a liar about what I am.
turns.after: I would rather agree with Him than win that argument.

turns.opener: how is your walk with God
turns.before: What steadies me is this. He let Himself be seen and heard. He did not leave me guessing.

turns.opener: how is your walk with God
turns.before: I want to know the life He is offering. Not only to know things about Him.

turns.opener: how is ministering to your neighbour going
turns.before: The woman next door tells me she has nothing to confess. She says she has no need of any of this.

turns.opener: how is ministering to your neighbour going
turns.before: She said it plainly. She has never sinned in her life.

turns.opener: how is ministering to your neighbour going
turns.before: She asked me why I keep coming back to her at all.

turns.opener: how is ministering to your neighbour going
turns.before: Another woman says she is right with God. But the way she lives says otherwise. I did not know what to tell her.

turns.opener: how is ministering to your neighbour going
turns.before: I want her to have what I have. To be brought into fellowship with the Father and His Son. Not to earn her way to Him.
turns.after: Then that is what I will keep telling her.

arc.occupation: I dye wool for the weavers who buy from me.
arc.trouble: I have done everything my mother taught me for the little gods at home, for twenty years, and not one of them has ever said a word back.
arc.summary: A middle-aged dyer who has practised her household religion faithfully all her life and heard nothing back from it, and who is certain she has nothing owing. She is answered first about the silence, then about her claim to be clear, and she stops paying and believes. Later she slips back into measuring herself and coming off well, is answered again, and ends by telling a customer what she was given.

turns.before: I am tired. I have set out food for the little gods at home since I was a girl, and I have never once heard anything back.
turns.after: Heard from Him. You are saying somebody actually heard something.

turns.before: Hearing a message is not the same as seeing anyone. Words can be passed along by anybody.
Touched with your hands? Then what you touched was a man, and a man dies like the rest of us.
turns.after: Eternal life, and you say you saw it. I have never had anything like that to hold on to.

turns.before: I believe I owe nothing. I have paid the gods since I was a girl, and there is no wrong of mine left over.
I would say the same thing again. I have not sinned.
turns.after: You are saying I am calling Him a liar. I did not expect the charge to run that way.

turns.before: If that is true, then what do I do with what is actually mine? I would not know where to begin putting it right.
turns.after: Confess. Not pay. That is not how I was taught any of this works.

turns.before: You say He died and rose. Why would a death of His do anything about wrong that is mine?
But I have been in the dark about Him my whole life, and I do not know what He is even like.
turns.after: No darkness at all. Every god I was given had a side you did not cross.

turns.before: How do you know any of this? You were not there when it happened.
Then I believe Him. I am done paying, and I want to be counted with you and with Him.

turns.opener: how is your walk with God
turns.before: I keep waiting for the old weight to come back on me, and it has not. I am not sure what to do with how glad I am.

turns.opener: how is your walk with God
turns.before: My hands still want the old gods. I catch myself reaching for them without thinking, and I do not want to be in both at once.
turns.after: Not both. I would rather be told that plainly than find it out later.

conversations.catch_up: I told my husband what I had done with the little gods at home. He has not said a word to me about it since, and he has not stopped me either.

turns.before: I want my husband to have what I have, and I do not know how to hand it to him.
But I did not see any of it myself. All I have is what you told me.
turns.after: So I say the message, not my own eyes. I can do that.

turns.before: My daughters watch me all day. I would rather they saw the truth in me than heard me claim something my life does not match.
One of my sons asked what is different now, and all I could tell him was that I have stopped paying.
turns.after: That is what is different. Something was paid, and it was not by me.

turns.opener: how is your walk with God
turns.before: I am glad, and I keep expecting the gladness to be taken off me for being too much.

turns.opener: how is your walk with God
turns.before: There is a thing I did years ago that I have never said out loud to anyone, and I have not said it to Him either.
turns.after: Faithful and just. I was afraid He would be neither, once He knew.

turns.opener: how is your walk with God
turns.before: I have said it to Him. Now I want to know what He is actually like, since I only ever knew what He was owed.

turns.opener: how is your walk with God
turns.before: I still wish I had seen Him. I would give a great deal to know this is not a story that grew in the telling.
turns.after: Touched. You keep saying it and I keep needing to hear it.

turns.opener: how is ministering to your neighbour going
turns.before: The woman who buys my wool keeps her gods the way I kept mine, and she tells me she has nothing to feel bad about.

turns.opener: how is ministering to your neighbour going
turns.before: I told her that, and she said she has never done a single wrong thing in her life.

turns.opener: how is ministering to your neighbour going
turns.before: She asked me why she should want your God at all, and I could not say what she would get.
turns.after: Eternal life. I should have started there, since that is what I was given.

conversations.catch_up: The woman who buys my wool has started asking me questions instead of arguing, and I did nothing to make that happen.

turns.before: I have started measuring myself against what I used to be, and coming off well. I can hear how that sounds.
I caught myself telling my daughter that I have nothing left to bring Him.
turns.after: I said it about myself and it landed on Him. I did not see that until now.

turns.before: Then I have things to bring Him again, and I am ashamed of how many.

turns.opener: how is your walk with God
turns.before: I brought them, and I am lighter than I have been in years. I did not know that was allowed to keep happening.

turns.opener: how is your walk with God
turns.before: There is one habit I have kept back from Him on purpose, and I have been keeping it quiet.
turns.after: Quiet is the darkness part. I have been telling myself it was only a small thing.

turns.opener: how is your walk with God
turns.before: I have let it go, and I want to be in the open with Him and with my own house.

turns.opener: how is ministering to your neighbour going
turns.before: The woman who buys my wool asked me straight out whether anybody actually saw Him.

turns.opener: how is ministering to your neighbour going
turns.before: She wanted to know what she would be getting if she did believe.
turns.after: This time I had it ready.

turns.opener: how is ministering to your neighbour going
turns.before: She told me the whole of what she has been carrying, and then asked me whether it could be dealt with.

turns.opener: how is ministering to your neighbour going
turns.before: She believed. My own gladness has doubled and I do not have words for it.
turns.after: Complete. That is the word I was reaching for.
